verdict.rationale: Postman docs confirm scripting capability for tests via pre-request/post-response scripts and reference writing 'a basic test to validate the API response,' supporting assertions generally. However, no evidence explicitly shows built-in pm.test/pm.response.to.have.status/header/body assertion syntax or code examples demonstrating status/body/header-specific assertions. missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of pm.test() syntax, pm.response.to.have.status(), header/body assertion helpers, and independent/hands-on corroboration of assertion authoring.
